title: Classic Mooncakes with Red Bean Paste - The Woks of Life
ldName: Classic Mooncakes with Red Bean Paste
ldIngredientsRaw: 830 ml water ((4 cups if cooking on the stove instead of an Instant Pot))
190 g rock sugar ((or 1 cup granulated sugar))
24  pre-cooked salted duck egg yolks ((or uncooked or pre-cooked salted duck eggs))
250 g golden syrup ((250g = 3/4 cup plus 1 tablespoon))
1 1/2 teaspoons Potassium Carbonate solution ((AKA lye water, available at your Chinese grocery store))
385 g all-purpose flour ((plus more for dusting))
ldInstructionsRaw: Prepare the salted duck egg yolks (optional):
